g.text: Japan: labor history and a migration coverage break
Migration lines are not connected across 2017–2018.
Dashed: Japanese nationals only (2011–2017). Solid: all nationalities (2018–2022). Calendar years.
Labor: all 47 prefectures, regional median; annual LFS model/ratio estimates with benchmark and disaster-year notes.
Sources: Japan LFS and Basic Resident Registration annual tables. Selected migration cases are illustrative.
